text.tspan: Communication · A² A1 · hub role collaboration
Multiple agents or components exchange messages.
A participant sends a message or requests
The mediator records routing and returns a
Participant bypass does not silently alter
1 compose(message) → 2 send(envelope) → 3 resolve(peer) → 4 return(address) → 5 deliver(message) → 6 return(response) → 7
Evidence: 5/41 repositories, 5/36 families; 5 trajectories (4 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Group-chat manager, coordinator interface, and message mediator.
Negative control: A shared global object is not necessarily a mediator.
